protocol.selection: Tune all settings on validation NDCG@10 with five liked films. For discovery select maximum validation catalog coverage subject to NDCG@10 >=98% of the selected accuracy model, breaking ties by NDCG. Fit three fixed neural seeds on the same users; select each epoch on validation. Freeze settings before a single reserve-user evaluation at histories 1/5/10.
protocol.disclosure: The initial benchmark was inspected. These reserve users were excluded from that pilot's test sample; this is not an unseen-dataset claim. The user split is not a global historical deployment simulation.

limitations: Original pilot test was already inspected; reserve protocol excludes those users.
Every model uses the same user split; neural seeds do not estimate split uncertainty.
Strong non-neural baselines are retained; selection may favor EASE-only fusion.
Observed ratings are selection-biased; offline ranking is not online engagement.
All catalog metadata is available; no item-cold-start claim is made.
Paired comparisons are descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted.

serving_model_selection.criterion: Highest validation NDCG@10 at five likes among all evaluated candidates.
serving_model_selection.timing: Serving selection correction applied after reserve scores were produced; no models or hyperparameters changed. Original optimized report preserved as optimized_initial.json.

additional_contrast_timing: Neural-ensemble and kNN paired intervals were added after the primary reserve report from frozen checkpoints and the same reserved users; no training or setting selection changed.
